say:2:1524304001:1.text: No way I'm going! I don't want to be a warrior! All that training's pointless—
say:2:1524304001:1.source_cn: 不去就是不去！我根本不想当战士，那些训练根本没用——

say:4:1524304003:0.text: Oh, it's Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Help! Mama's trying to drag me off to training again!
say:4:1524304003:0.male: Oh, it's Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Help! Mama's trying to drag me off to training again!
say:4:1524304003:0.female: Oh, it's Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Help! Mama's trying to drag me off to training again!

choice_prompt:5:1524304003.text: Oh, it's Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Help! Mama's trying to drag me off to training again!
choice_prompt:5:1524304003.source_cn: 咦，是<style=stress><player_name></style>老师！你快帮我劝劝阿娘吧，她又要拖着我去训练了！
choice_prompt:5:1524304003.male: Oh, it's Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Help! Mama's trying to drag me off to training again!
choice_prompt:5:1524304003.female: Oh, it's Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Help! Mama's trying to drag me off to training again!

say:6:1524304004:0.text: Gala? What can Roli do for her?
say:6:1524304004:0.male: Gala? What can Roli do for her?
say:6:1524304004:0.female: Gala? What can Roli do for her?

say:7:1524304005:1.text: You tell Kal and Roli about the pest problem in Mirehold and that you will need Roli's help to cast the expulsion spell.
say:7:1524304005:1.source_cn: 你将水泽营地遭遇虫灾，需要叫上绒利一起帮忙布置驱虫魔法...

say:8:1524304006:0.text: You make it sound a bit worse than it really is, but no one needs to know...
say:8:1524304006:0.source_cn: 当然，在“农田虫害严重程度”方面，你进行了一些小小的夸...

say:9:1524304007:0.text: What?! Is the situation that bad?!
say:9:1524304007:0.source_cn: 什么，水泽营地的农田虫害怎么会这么严重？

say:10:1524304008:0.text: I told you magic can solve a lot of problems! Let me help!
say:10:1524304008:0.source_cn: 我就说魔法很有用，我要去帮忙！

say:11:1524304009:0.text: This is for the sake of the entire Wildborn! You can't stop me this time, Mama!
say:11:1524304009:0.source_cn: 我现在要去帮雅库伯尔做很重要的正事！阿娘，这次你不能拦...

say:12:1524304010:0.text: Warriors can also deal with bugs. No need to involve magic.
say:12:1524304010:0.source_cn: 处理虫害这种事战士就能做得到，没必要用什么魔法。

say:13:1524304011:0.text: I'll come with you and take care of the pests.
say:13:1524304011:0.source_cn: 我和你们一起去，这件事交给我做就行了。

say:14:1524304012:0.text: Roli, pay attention to my moves. Consider it an agility lesson.
say:14:1524304012:0.source_cn: 绒利，记得认真看，就当是给你上一节战士敏捷技巧的实操课了。

choice:5:0:1.text: You have to skip training today.
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 你的确不能去参加训练
choice:5:0:1.male: You have to skip training today.
choice:5:0:1.female: You have to skip training today.
